name: Hims & Hers Health
description: Hims & Hers is a subscription brand for prescription and over-the-counter treatments (hair loss, sexual health, dermatology, mental health and, since it began selling GLP-1 weight-loss drugs, a large weight-loss line). Customers sign up online, see a physician on the company's affiliated telehealth network, and receive medication by mail on a recurring schedule, mostly filled by outside 'compounding' pharmacies and its own facilities. It had 2.89 million subscribers at 2026-06-30 paying $92 a month on average. Revenue nearly tripled from 2023 to 2025 but the company now reports an operating loss (Q2 2026: -$97M) after a June 2026 acquisition of Australian telehealth company Eucalyptus and a February 2026 FDA statement that it intends to restrict the ingredients used in compounded GLP-1 drugs.

businessLines.name: United States
businessLines.how: Recurring subscription revenue: the customer pays each shipment cycle (monthly to quarterly) for medication plus the physician consultation; revenue is the product and service fee, with prescription cost of goods and pharmacy/shipping costs as the main expenses.
businessLines.description: Online telehealth-plus-pharmacy subscription business in the US.

businessLines.name: Rest of World
businessLines.how: Same subscription telehealth model in newly acquired foreign markets.
businessLines.description: UK, EU, Canada (from 2025 acquisitions), and Australia/Japan via Eucalyptus (acquired June 2026).

brands.name: Hims (men) and Hers (women)
brands.note: Brand-level revenue not disclosed in text read
